    "冷调电影级光影",
    "克制非血腥击杀呈现",
    "皇家禁地肃杀氛围"

  },

      "mobility": "bipedal",
      "reference_mode": "identity"

    {

      "mobility": "bipedal",
      "reference_mode": "identity"
    }
  ],
